thread:
sam-sales: Need sizing for VegaCorp demo Thurs. They want 99p <= 320ms. Baseline ~6 rps, bursts up to ~55 rps for ~10m twice/day. Token mix ~70% short (<=64t), 30% long (>=800t). Ask: reserved GPU suggestion + autoscale policy + KV prewarm plan + pricing uplift.

vik-eng: quick Qs: single region? model family? are long requests concurrent or queued?

sam-sales: single region (us-east-1). Using redwood-llama-13b-int8. Longs are decode-heavy nightly jobs and some daytime spikes.

zoe-se: My recommendation: reserve 2 x A100-80GB for low-latency short flows and add 1 reserved prewarm/pinned slot dedicated to large-decode jobs (total reserved = 3). Allow autoscale burst up to +3 on-demand/spot for the 55 rps transients. Prewarm top_200 KV prefixes and pin weights on the prewarm slot to avoid cold-starts.

grant-infra: Ops notes: spread reserved pool across 2 AZs (2/1). Burst pool can be spot-first with automatic fallback to quantized model (llama-13b-quant) on eviction. Set autoscale cooldown to ~90s to avoid flapping. Tag latency-sensitive routes to prefer reserved pool.

vik-eng: Perf ballpark: with batching tuned for short chat ~1300 tok/s per A100; decoding-heavy long requests drop to ~600 tok/s. Back-of-envelope GPU-hours: reserved 3 GPUs = 3 * 24 * 30 = 2160 GPU-hrs/month. Estimated burst (avg 1.5 GPUs * 6h/day) ~270h/month. Total ~2430 GPU-hrs/month (billing counts actual burst hours).

anya-pm: Pricing: propose ~17% discount on GPU hourly for a 12mo commitment + include 150 burst credits (1 credit = 1 GPU-hour). We'll present expected and conservative (x1.8 burst) scenarios in the quote.

sam-sales: sample autoscale snippet to include in the handoff (explain in prose too):
```json
{"min_reserved":3,"prewarm":1,"scale_triggers":["rps>12","queue_depth>30","gpu_util>70"],"scale_step":1,"max_burst":3,"cooldown_s":90,"fallback":"llama-13b-quant","kv_preload":"top_200"}
```
Explain prewarm pins model weights + warms KV; cooldown avoids oscillation; fallback routes to quantized model on spot eviction.

deploy-bot: Action created: prewarm-job request queued (will run after handoff doc approved).

sam-sales: I'll draft the presales handoff with sizing rationale, autoscale snippet, AZ/spot fallback notes, and pricing sketch. Tagging @zoe-se for the runbook and @grant-infra for ops wording. Happy to join customer call if needed. End of thread.
